hero.title: International Business in the USA for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Pursue an accredited degree in International Business in the USA, mastering global market expansion, multinational corporate strategy, cross-border supply chains, and foreign trade. International students acquire cross-cultural leadership skills and explore Optional Practical Training (OPT) employment opportunities, subject to US immigration regulations.

overview: Studying in the USA offers Indian students unmatched academic prestige, cutting-edge research facilities, flexible curriculums, and access to the world's largest job market.

Edu Hawk Worldwide Consultancy guides Indian students through Common App and university portals, GRE/GMAT/IELTS prep, I-20 procurement, DS-160 and F-1 visa interview preparation, and 3-year STEM OPT employment pathways.
